files.content:
# Examples/Teams (Fluent 2)

Microsoft Teams in Fluent 2: tabs first, then search.

Install emoji-picker-react 5 or later, import './picker.css', then render <PickerExample className="teams-picker" />. Pass onEmojiClick to insert the chosen emoji into your app. For CSS Modules, import picker.module.css and pass styles.picker as className. This snippet is the picker only; the surrounding demo app chrome is not included.
